note.p:
Processing argument: Enables unfiltered SSHJ TRACE logging for SSH and SFTP operations when log_level is set to TRACE .
By default, TRACE logging is suppressed for the following classes to prevent sensitive packet data from being exposed in logs and to avoid excessive log output during file transfers:
net.schmizz.sshj.transport.Encoder
net.schmizz.sshj.transport.Decoder
net.schmizz.sshj.connection.channel.direct.SessionChannel
